BiblicalUsage: Gerizim is a mountain of Palestine, named 4 times in Scripture, in Deuteronomy, Joshua, and Judges. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: God met His people at Gerizim, a real place in His story, and that is why I take its name seriously. I hold that even a place the Bible names only briefly is worth knowing.
